content: pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 (May 2026) is the latest. asyncio_mode=auto is recommended for asyncio-only projects; strict requires explicit @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators. asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope should be set explicitly to 'function' to avoid deprecation warnings. The event_loop fixture was removed in 1.0 — use @pytest_asyncio.fixture(loop_scope='module') instead. For FastAPI + aiosqlite: use pytest_asyncio fixtures, override app dependencies to inject test DB, use httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport(app=app). Lifespan events require asgi-lifespan LifespanManager or httpx lifespan=app parameter.
